name: .35 Winchester
text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If a +1, 0, or [elder_sign] chaos token is revealed during this attack, this attack deals +2 damage.
text_cn: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。(FAQ, v1.7)这次攻击你+2[combat]。如果这次攻击中抽出+1、0或[elder_sign]混乱标记，这次攻击造成+2伤害。
